label: Week 32, 2026
recap:
This week was fairly quiet, with 12 bill movements and 7 case updates recorded across three jurisdictions. Congress accounted for the bulk of activity with 8 items, followed by California with 3 and North Carolina with 1. Among the themes that appeared, health care and transparency and disclosure each showed up twice, touching on things like clinical decision support and labeling AI-generated output, while employment and hiring, infrastructure and energy, and workforce and education each appeared once. Seven bills did not fall under any tracked theme.

Overall, the week reflected modest, spread-out activity rather than a concentrated push in any one direction. No federal documents were logged for this period. The movements recorded reflect changes in bill status, not passage or enactment, and the case updates likewise represent changes to existing records rather than new rulings. Taken together, the data suggests a period of incremental procedural activity across a small number of jurisdictions and themes.
